messages:
anya: FYI I'm seeing repeated p95/p99 jitter from the rack18 GPU hosts over the last hour. Looks correlated with large short-lived egress bursts from a couple of tenants.

anya: Quick probe: NIC IRQ distribution is wildly uneven; some hosts show hw queues 0/1 handling 80% of rx. ethtool + dmesg snippets below.

anya: ```
# ethtool -S eth0 | grep queue
queue0_rx: 8200000
queue1_rx: 1200000
queue2_rx: 90000
queue3_rx: 45000
# dmesg | grep -i irq
eth0: RSS steering moved flow, softirq backlog spikes
```

ben: Could be driver/firmware mismatch + default irqbalance behavior. Any recent node reboots or kernel updates in that AZ?

anya: Rolled kernel 5.15.62 last week on half the rack. The others still 5.15.58. Suspect small RSS hash differences between versions causing hash collision on queues.

colt: Two-prong plan: 1) short-term: enable per-tenant soft egress policer + pin offending 5-tuple hashes across queues; 2) medium-term: schedule a coordinated kernel/firmware roll so all hosts share RSS behavior.

iris: For (1) we can use soft isolation (no carveout) and introduce a temporary "burst-credit" flag for tenants so they can burst but be billed premium if they hit sustained usage. Helps product justify ephemeral carveouts. Thoughts?

ben: I like burst-credit. Operationally we apply token-bucket policer w/ a refill window and allow burst consumption up to X for Y minutes. If exceeded, throttle. Works as a middle ground vs dedicated slice.

anya: Implemented RSS pinning for the top offending flows and applied policer rule bc-1201 to tenant=vision-index on hosts [rack18-node3, rack18-node4].

ops-bot: Action: policer bc-1201 applied. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/egress-policer. Monitor window set to 15m.

colt: Early metrics: p95 fell from 380ms -> 170ms, p99 from 1.05s -> 420ms. Latency improved but we still see transient tails when multiple tenants burst simultaneously.

iris: Can you sketch billing model for burst-credit so we can brief sales? Example: baseline shared rate + 2x per-GB for consumed burst above threshold, or hourly ephemeral slice fee if carveout requested.

billing-bot: Preliminary calc: if customer takes 2h ephemeral 0.25 slice = prorated monthly cost ~ $X (placeholder). Burst-credit per-GB at 2x shared egress rate would roughly recover additional infra risk + ops overhead. Tag me on the ticket for exact numbers.

ben: Also schedule a kernel/firmware homogenization next maintenance window. If we align RSS behavior across nodes we reduce hash drift. Add note about testing irqbalance and disabling aggressive coalescing for GPUs.

anya: I'll open INF-5077 and attach the perf graphs, tcpdump excerpt, and the cost options for burst-credit vs ephemeral carveout. Pinging account team if they want to accept burst premium.

ops-bot: Reminder: paste timeline and mitigation choices into INF-5077 when resolved. :memo:

anya: Thanks all. Will monitor for the next 15m and escalate if policer saturates. :thumbsup:
